# Digital Skills and Jobs Platform

> The EU's central hub for digital skills development, training opportunities, and career pathways across Europe, connecting learners with resources, initiatives, and funding to bridge the digital skills gap.

This platform aggregates European and national digital transformation initiatives, training catalogs, and funding opportunities to support upskilling and reskilling across EU member states. It serves as a community hub for sharing best practices, tracking progress toward Digital Decade targets, and connecting individuals with learning resources in emerging technologies like AI, cybersecurity, and cloud computing.

## Core Initiatives & Strategy

- [Home | Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en): Central hub for EU digital skills information and Digital Skills & Jobs Community
- [EU and National actions | Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/initiatives): European and national digital transition initiatives and strategies
- [EU Initiatives I Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/initiatives/european-initiatives): EU upskilling programs including Digital Europe, Union of Skills, STEM initiatives
- [National strategies – Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/initiatives/national-strategies): EU member state digital skills policies and nationwide transformation initiatives
- [Funding opportunities I Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/initiatives/funding): EU, national, and regional grants, loans, and financial instruments for digital skills
- [European Digital Skills Awards 2025 | Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/initiatives/european-digital-skills-awards-2026): Annual awards recognizing best digital skills projects and initiatives across EU
- [State of play | Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/initiatives/european-interactive-map): Interactive map showing EU digital skills statistics and country comparisons

## Learning & Training Resources

- [Opportunities | Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/learning-space): Training, funding, and career opportunities in digital skills across Europe
- [Training offers I Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/learning-space/training-catalogue): Comprehensive directory of digital skills courses from beginner to expert level
- [Learning Content I Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/learning-space/learning-content): Curated learning resources including MOOCs, AI, coding, and data management
- [Learning Path I Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/learning-space/learning-path): Guided learning pathways for blockchain, AI, and professional skill development
- [Resources I Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/learning-space/resources): Self-assessment tools, curricula, and learning materials for digital upskilling
- [Self-assessment tools | Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/learning-space/self-assessment-tools): DigComp-based assessment tools including DigSAT and MyDigiSkills for skill evaluation

## Impact & Best Practices

- [Inspiration | Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/impact-shapers): Good practices, case studies, and research on digital skills across Europe
- [Good practices – Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/impact-shapers/good-practices): Successful digital skills initiatives and replicable approaches at regional/local level
- [Pledges | Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/impact-shapers/pledges): Organizational commitments to Digital Decade targets and skills development goals

## News, Events & Community

- [Latest I Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/latest): News, expert insights, events, and research publications on digital skills/jobs
- [Digital Skills Talks Series | Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/latest/digital-skills-talks-series): Webinar series featuring industry experts discussing digital skills and AI topics
- [Events – Digital Skills and Jobs Platform](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/latest/events): Calendar of webinars, workshops, and conferences on digital skills and STEAM

## User Access & Support

- [EU Login](https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/en/eulogin): Authentication and account management via EU Login with eID/EIDAS support
